records.canonicalQuestion: Why is document-center R1A graph contribution blocked after Mode C intake?
alternateQuestions: Which Supabase tables are authoritative for Rosewood cover and sheet index?
records.shortAnswer: Hybrid WP uses document_plan_sets/cover_fields/sheet_index_runs; some drafts and migration 802 still cite document_extraction_runs/plan_extracted_fields — reconcile before Master Graph ingest.
records.detailedAnswer: Documents plan-intelligence schema drift blocks graph contribution

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Intake or WP cites document_extraction_runs or document_plan_extracted_fields for Rosewood R1A
runPreflight: List plan-intelligence migrations and live Supabase table presence
doNot: Compile Master Graph contribution from mixed old/new table names
Treat seed extraction_run UUID from superseded draft as live
proveBeforeClaiming: One schema family selected and applied

records.canonicalQuestion: Should CLASSIFIED_AS window_schedule be a canonical edge or an assertion?
alternateQuestions: How do conflicting OCR and human corrections coexist in Master Graph?
records.shortAnswer: CLASSIFIED_AS, cover field values, and contested extractions stay Observation→Assertion→Evidence→Decision; do not bake confidence onto identity edges.
records.detailedAnswer: Machine claims are assertions — not silent canonical edges

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Parser or agent proposes a classification or cover field as graph truth
doNot: Attach review_status only onto durable identity edges
Delete machine assertion when human corrects — append Decision
proveBeforeClaiming: subject uses source UUID not OCR string

records.canonicalQuestion: Which Graph Intake file should I attach to a chat?
alternateQuestions: What is Mode A Compact vs Mode B Rosewood vs Mode C full questionnaire?
records.shortAnswer: Default drop GRAPH-INTAKE-OPERATOR-PROMPTS-v1.md; add AGENT-CONTRACT for rules, ROSEWOOD-FIXTURE for pilot IDs, FULL-QUESTIONNAIRE for Mode C design.
records.detailedAnswer: Graph Intake Pack v3 — which file to drop in chat

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Operator wants Master Graph growth advice from a paste
runPreflight: Attach OPERATOR-PROMPTS only unless Mode C / Rosewood IDs needed
doNot: Force every chat through the full questionnaire
Jump to openings/qty/pricing before Phase 1 IDs
proveBeforeClaiming: Response uses buckets Ready/Needs IDs/Needs schema/Needs human/Outside
Growth phase labeled 1-5 with evidence rules

records.canonicalQuestion: Is sheet:a.520.1 a safe Master Graph ID?
alternateQuestions: How should duplicate sheet numbers in one plan set be identified?
records.shortAnswer: Rosewood has duplicate sheet labels; canonical sheet id is sheet:<document_sheets.uuid>; sheetNumber and pdfPageNumber are properties/aliases only.
records.detailedAnswer: Never use sheet labels alone as Master Graph identity

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Graph seed or contribution uses sheet:A.520.1 or similar label id
runPreflight: Confirm document_sheets UUID exists for the page binding
doNot: Use sheet label as sole graph identity
Collapse duplicate labels without explicit equivalence
proveBeforeClaiming: 0 sheet identities based solely on labels
pdfPageNumber present as property when needed
